topics.title: Multi-Source Lead Ingestion & Deduplication
topics.objective: Ingest inbound leads from forms, webinars, and partner APIs with automated email deduplication.
topics.example: Lead: { email: 'cto@acme.com', company: 'Acme Corp', source: 'Webinar', enriched: false }
topics.exercise: Build an ingestion API deduplicating incoming contacts by corporate email domain.

topics.title: Behavioral & Demographic Lead Scoring Models
topics.objective: Assign real-time points based on buyer persona match and intent actions (pricing page visits, whitepaper downloads).
topics.exercise: Implement a real-time lead scoring calculator promoting leads to MQL (Marketing Qualified) at 100 points.

topics.title: Round-Robin Sales Representative Routing
topics.objective: Distribute qualified leads fairly across regional sales representatives based on territory and availability.
topics.exercise: Create a round-robin assignment queue skipping representatives currently on leave or at max capacity.

topics.title: Deal Pipeline Stages & Opportunity Forecasting
topics.objective: Track deal stages from Discovery to Closed-Won with weighted probability revenue forecasting.
topics.exercise: Build an opportunity forecasting view computing quarterly expected ARR across all active pipeline stages.

topics.title: Sales Activity Tracking & CRM Analytics
topics.objective: Measure SDR outreach velocity, call connects, email click rates, and sales cycle duration.
topics.exercise: Design a CRM executive dashboard visualising lead velocity rate and rep conversion performance.
